sn47.20:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati sedakannāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.
sn47.20:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave janapadakalyāṇī janapadakalyāṇīti kho bhikkhave mahājanakāyo sannipateyya.
sn47.20:2.2: sā kho pana janapadakalyāṇī paramapāsāvinī nacce paramapāsāvinī gīte
sn47.20:2.3: janapadakalyāṇī naccati gāyatīti kho bhikkhave bhiyyoso mattāya mahājanakāyo sannipateyya.
sn47.20:2.4: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo
sn47.20:2.6: ayante ambho purisa samatittiko telapatto antarena ca mahāsamajjaṃ antarena ca janapadakalyāṇiyā pariharitabbo.
sn47.20:2.7: puriso ca tena ukkhittāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati
sn47.20:2.8: yattheva naṃ thokaṃpi chaḍḍessasi tattheva te siro pātissatīti.
sn47.20:2.10: api nu so puriso amuṃ telapattaṃ amanasikaritvā bahiddhā pamādaṃ āhareyyāti.
sn47.20:3.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn47.20:3.3: samatittiko telapattoti kho bhikkhave kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.
sn47.20:3.5: kāyagatā sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti.
